item.stem:
Ira looks at the diagram. On the same flat page, lines $\ell$ and $m$ are each perpendicular to line $n$.

Which claim correctly decides how $\ell$ and $m$ relate?

options.A: $\ell$ is parallel to $m$, because both are perpendicular to the same line $n$ on the same flat page.
options.B: Call the answer the shared reference line $n$ itself.
options.C: Call $\ell$ and $m$ parallel even if they need not stay on the same flat page.
options.D: Treat the right-angle marks as also proving that $n$ is parallel to $\ell$.
